children: On August 27, 2026, the company received an Additional Staff Determination from Nasdaq citing its failure to file the Form 10-Q for the period ended June 30, 2026 as another basis for delisting. Nasdaq had previously issued staff determinations to delist for not meeting MVLS of $50 million and MVPHS of $15 million; the company has requested a hearing, intends to seek an extended stay by September 3, 2026, and its stock remains listed pending the panel’s decision.
